scripts.setup: cp -n .env.example .env && cp -n api/.env.example api/.env && cp -n web/.env.example web/.env && npm run build && npm run compose -- run --rm api sh -c 'grep -q
.env || php artisan key:generate' && npm run migrate
scripts.dev:api: npm run compose -- up api worker
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:api: npm run compose -- run --rm api composer test
scripts.test:web: npm run compose -- run --rm web bun run test
scripts.lint: npm run lint:api && npm run lint:web
scripts.lint:api: npm run compose -- run --rm api composer lint
scripts.lint:web: npm run compose -- run --rm web bun run lint
scripts.migrate: npm run compose -- run --rm api php artisan migrate --force
